vendored: SHA256SUMS is the complete upstream index; this directory holds the config schema, literal registry, management warning schema, manifest and config fixtures it lists. The corpus and wire fixtures stay with the Rust runner.
update_procedure: Never edit a vendored file in place. A changed expectation needs a new contract version upstream and a review explanation there.

To move to a new version: check out the harness at the released revision to vendor, copy the same files from source_path into a sibling directory named after the new contract version, and delete this one.
Record the release, revision, component versions and the SHA-256 of the upstream SHA256SUMS file (shasum -a 256 SHA256SUMS) in the new SOURCE.json.
Point CONTRACT_DIR in test_facade_config_validation.py at the new directory.
